setup.text: A group of villagers lies in hammocks while children play nearby, and nothing urgent needs attention.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (villager) falls asleep to the sound of leaves.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: Someone wakes with an amusing imprint of woven fibers on their cheek.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A lively debate begins over which fruit is best.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The group eats in companionable silence.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) invents rules nobody else can follow.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (villager) declares doing nothing a skill worth mastering.

text_only.reason: "skill" in the everyday sense, not a skill gain -- the volume's outcomes are story text unless an effect is marked
